verdict.rationale: The only related evidence is the grok-4.7 per-model spec page, which lists modalities, context window, capability flags and pricing, and is explicitly described as "a specification card, not a safety/system card." Nothing in the pack shows a published model or system card covering training approach, evaluation results or intended use for the flagship model. A spec page is an adjacent artifact and earns no credit.

support.subject: As an ml-engineer, I can read a published model card or system card — capabilities, training approach, evaluation results, and intended use — for the current flagship model
